Bun lock: retain target dependency versions and inherited Bun 1.4.0 jiti resolution layout; frozen install does not modify lock.
Helm appVersion becomes 0.21.0 and chart package version remains 0.1.8; PR lint/render/package/unpublished-version checks pass; no extra bump.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Fix(agent): don't detect zypper-aptitude's apt-get wrapper as apt (#2523). Confirm collector units, reset/error behavior, build-tag selection, and unchanged default behavior.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: Adds per-monitor skipTlsVerify for HTTPS probes only, default false; UI makes the weakened verification explicit, non-HTTP protocols clear it, and migration adds a boolean. Keep the secure default and per-monitor scope.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Fix(charts): show isolated points and stop endless spinner on empty values (#2514). Rebuild the embedded UI with the pinned Bun lockfile and verify the associated user flow.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Refactor(agent): share cgroup path vars and v2 mount lookup. Confirm collector units, reset/error behavior, build-tag selection, and unchanged default behavior.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: Hub sends keepalive pings between polls while an Agent is slow, preventing a healthy connection from expiring during long collection.

upstream_commits.subject: fix(hub): stop keepalive pings after prolonged agent silence
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Keepalive pings stop after three minutes without an Agent message; retain the stale-peer cutoff while allowing slow but active collection.

P2 dependency hardening; no reachable production exploit path is demonstrated by these call sites.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: Lockfiles resolve the update to valibot 1.5.0 and Vite 7.3.7 at the frozen target. upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Fix(site): keep last known update count in systems table when host is down (#2559). Rebuild the embedded UI with the pinned Bun lockfile and verify the associated user flow.

upstream_commits.risk_summary: ZFS pool status text now flows through Agent structures, Hub persistence, a PocketBase migration, and UI; verify old records default cleanly and migration rollback removes only the added field.

upstream_commits.subject: fix(agent): reset host CPU baseline after counter rollback
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Fix(agent): reset host CPU baseline after counter rollback. Confirm collector units, reset/error behavior, build-tag selection, and unchanged default behavior.

upstream_commits.subject: fix: handle cached NVMe failures and empty SMART responses

upstream_commits.subject: fix(agent): widen NVMe unsafe_shutdowns to uint (#2583)
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Fix(agent): widen NVMe unsafe_shutdowns to uint (#2583). Keep Agent-Hub field tags, omitted-value behavior, and older Hub/Agent compatibility stable.

upstream_commits.subject: fix: use omitzero for scalar JSON fields under json v2
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Scalar JSON fields move from omitempty to omitzero for json v2 behavior; CBOR tags remain the wire format, but JSON response shape must stay compatible across json v1/v2 paths.

upstream_commits.subject: fix(agent): parse intel_gpu_top -J arrays that omit commas between samples (#2589)
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Fix(agent): parse intel_gpu_top -J arrays that omit commas between samples (#2589). Confirm collector units, reset/error behavior, build-tag selection, and unchanged default behavior.

upstream_commits.subject: perf(agent): reuse buffer when reading intel_gpu_top samples
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Perf(agent): reuse buffer when reading intel_gpu_top samples. Confirm collector units, reset/error behavior, build-tag selection, and unchanged default behavior.

upstream_commits.subject: feat(agent): support custom WebSocket headers with `HUB_HEADERS`  (#2585)
upstream_commits.risk_summary: HUB_HEADERS parses and validates custom Agent WebSocket headers before dialing; preserve default handshake behavior and ensure invalid values fail closed without changing authorization semantics.

upstream_commits.subject: systemd: include user journals in service logs (#2553)
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Reviewed first-parent patch: Systemd: include user journals in service logs (#2553). Confirm collector units, reset/error behavior, build-tag selection, and unchanged default behavior.

upstream_commits.subject: fix(hub): keep the updater running when the system record lookup fails (#2588)
upstream_commits.risk_summary: Missing system rows no longer terminate the system updater, while other record lookup errors still return; preserve the distinction between deletion and transient DB failure.

upstream_commits.subject: fix(site): unsubscribe live metrics that resolve after leaving 1m (#2599)

upstream_commits.risk_summary: NVMe controller-to-namespace fallback selections persist across rescans under a lock; ensure device removal/reappearance does not retain invalid namespace paths.

pre_merge_snapshot.workflow:
name: iOS Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - iOS
    # NOTE: path filters are NOT evaluated for tag pushes by GitHub Actions,
    # so iOS release tags always run the full build + release pipeline below,
    # while branch pushes to `iOS` still skip docs-only changes.
    tags:
      - "v*-ios.*"
    paths:
      - "*.go"
      - "**/*.go"
      - "internal/site/**"
      - "go.mod"
      - "go.sum"
      - "go.work"
      - "go.work.sum"
      - ".github/workflows/ios-build.yml"
      - ".github/scripts/patch-go-ios-arm64-runtime.py"
      - "tests/ios-patch-sentinels.sh"
      - "tests/upstream-sync-test.sh"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-ios:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run iOS maintenance sentinels
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sh tests/ios-patch-sentinels.sh
          sh tests/upstream-sync-test.sh

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Patch Go runtime for legacy iOS ARM64
        run: sudo python3 .github/scripts/patch-go-ios-arm64-runtime.py

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.0

      - name: Build web UI
        working-directory: internal/site
        run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun run build

      - name: Show environment
        run: |
          go version
          xcodebuild -version
          xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path
          xcrun --sdk iphoneos --find clang

      - name: Create iOS clang wrapper
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ios-clangwrap.sh" <<'WRAP'
          #!/bin/sh
          SDK_PATH="$(xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path)"
          CLANG="$(xcrun --sdk iphoneos --find clang)"

          exec "$CLANG" \
            -arch arm64 \
            -isysroot "$SDK_PATH" \
            -mios-version-min=12.0 \
            "$@"
          WRAP

          chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/ios-clangwrap.sh"

      - name: Build Beszel agent for iOS arm64
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/ios

          CGO_ENABLED=1 \
          GOOS=ios \
          GOARCH=arm64 \
          CC="$RUNNER_TEMP/ios-clangwrap.sh" \
          go build \
            -trimpath \
            -ldflags="-s -w" \
            -o build/ios/beszel-agent-ios-arm64 \
            ./internal/cmd/agent

      - name: Build Beszel hub for iOS arm64
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/ios

          CGO_ENABLED=1 \
          GOOS=ios \
          GOARCH=arm64 \
          CC="$RUNNER_TEMP/ios-clangwrap.sh" \
          go build \
            -trimpath \
            -ldflags="-s -w" \
            -o build/ios/beszel-hub-ios-arm64 \
            ./internal/cmd/hub

      - name: Verify Mach-O outputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for bin in build/ios/beszel-agent-ios-arm64 build/ios/beszel-hub-ios-arm64; do
            echo "== $bin =="
            if [ ! -s "$bin" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: missing or empty binary: $bin" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            file "$bin"
            if ! file "$bin" | grep -q "Mach-O"; then
              echo "ERROR: not a Mach-O binary: $bin" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            if ! file "$bin" | grep -q "arm64"; then
              echo "ERROR: not an arm64 binary: $bin" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            otool -hv "$bin"
            if ! otool -l "$bin" | grep -Eq 'LC_BUILD_VERSION|LC_VERSION_MIN_IPHONEOS'; then
              echo "ERROR: missing iOS version load command in $bin" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            otool -l "$bin" | grep -A8 -E 'LC_BUILD_VERSION|LC_VERSION_MIN_IPHONEOS'
            load_commands="$(otool -l "$bin")"
            if ! printf '%s\n' "$load_commands" | awk '
              $1 == "cmd" && $2 == "LC_BUILD_VERSION" { section = "build"; next }
              $1 == "cmd" && $2 == "LC_VERSION_MIN_IPHONEOS" { section = "legacy"; next }
              $1 == "cmd" { section = ""; next }
              section == "build" && $1 == "minos" && $2 == "12.0" { found = 1 }
              section == "legacy" && $1 == "version" && $2 == "12.0" { found = 1 }
              END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
            '; then
              echo "ERROR: iOS deployment load command does not set minimum version to 12.0 in $bin" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Generate SHA256SUMS
        shell: bash
        working-directory: build/ios
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shasum -a 256 beszel-agent-ios-arm64 beszel-hub-ios-arm64 > SHA256SUMS
          cat SHA256SUMS

      - name: Verify SHA256SUMS
        shell: bash
        working-directory: build/ios
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS

      - name: Upload iOS release payload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: beszel-ios-arm64
          path: |
            build/ios/beszel-agent-ios-arm64
            build/ios/beszel-hub-ios-arm64
            build/ios/SHA256SUMS

  release-ios:
    needs: build-ios
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref_name, '-ios.')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate iOS release tag format
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:?GITHUB_REF_NAME is empty}"
          echo "Validating iOS release tag: ${TAG}"
          if [ ! -f beszel.go ]; then
            echo "ERROR: beszel.go not found at tag checkout" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          BASE_VERSION="$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*Version[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\(.*\)".*/\1/p' beszel.go | head -n 1)"
          if [ -z "${BASE_VERSION}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: could not read beszel.Version from beszel.go" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Base Beszel version from source: ${BASE_VERSION}"
          echo "BASE_VERSION=${BASE_VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          ESCAPED_VERSION="$(printf '%s' "${BASE_VERSION}" | sed 's/\./\\./g')"
          EXPECTED_PATTERN="^v${ESCAPED_VERSION}-ios\\.[1-9][0-9]*$"
          if ! printf '%s' "${TAG}" | grep -Eq "${EXPECTED_PATTERN}"; then
            echo "ERROR: tag '${TAG}' does not match required format 'v${BASE_VERSION}-ios.<positive integer>'" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Tag format OK: ${TAG}"

      - name: Verify tag belongs to iOS history
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:?GITHUB_REF_NAME is empty}"
          TAG_SHA="$(git rev-list -n 1 "${TAG}")"
          echo "Tag ${TAG} points at ${TAG_SHA}"
          git fetch origin iOS --no-tags
          if git merge-base --is-ancestor "${TAG_SHA}" origin/iOS; then
            echo "Tag commit is in iOS branch history: OK"
          else
            echo "ERROR: tag ${TAG} (${TAG_SHA}) is not an ancestor of origin/iOS; refusing to release" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Download iOS build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: beszel-ios-arm64
          path: dist

      - name: Verify release payload
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd dist
          for f in beszel-agent-ios-arm64 beszel-hub-ios-arm64 SHA256SUMS; do
            if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: missing payload file: $f" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            if [ ! -s "$f" ]; then
              echo "ERROR: empty payload file: $f" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "--- SHA256SUMS ---"
          cat SHA256SUMS
          if [ "$(wc -l < SHA256SUMS | tr -d ' ')" != "2" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: SHA256SUMS must contain exactly 2 entries" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64} [ *]beszel-agent-ios-arm64$' SHA256SUMS; then
            echo "ERROR: SHA256SUMS missing valid beszel-agent-ios-arm64 entry" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64} [ *]beszel-hub-ios-arm64$' SHA256SUMS; then
            echo "ERROR: SHA256SUMS missing valid beszel-hub-ios-arm64 entry" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
          echo "Payload verification OK"
          ls -l

      - name: Publish GitHub Release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:?GITHUB_REF_NAME is empty}"
          BASE_VERSION="${BASE_VERSION:?BASE_VERSION is empty (tag validation must run first)}"
          NOTES_FILE="$(mktemp)"
          cat > "${NOTES_FILE}" <<EOF
          Beszel iOS ${TAG} - unofficial community port of Beszel, based on Beszel ${BASE_VERSION}.

          - Native Agent and Hub binaries for jailbroken iOS (arm64)
          - Validated on: iPad mini 2 (Apple A7, iOS 12.5.7)
          - Broader device compatibility remains untested
          - Verify checksums after download: run shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
          - Upstream Beszel: https://github.com/henrygd/beszel
          EOF
          gh release create "${TAG}" \
            --title "Beszel iOS ${TAG}" \
            --notes-file "${NOTES_FILE}" \
            --latest \
            dist/beszel-agent-ios-arm64 dist/beszel-hub-ios-arm64 dist/SHA256SUMS

      - name: Verify published release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:?GITHUB_REF_NAME is empty}"
          REPO="${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "== release view =="
          gh release view "${TAG}" --json tagName,name,isDraft,isPrerelease,assets
          DRAFT="$(gh release view "${TAG}" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft)"
          PRERELEASE="$(gh release view "${TAG}" --json isPrerelease --jq .isPrerelease)"
          [ "${DRAFT}" = "false" ] || { echo "ERROR: release ${TAG} is a draft" >&2; exit 1; }
          [ "${PRERELEASE}" = "false" ] || { echo "ERROR: release ${TAG} is marked prerelease" >&2; exit 1; }
          for asset in beszel-agent-ios-arm64 beszel-hub-ios-arm64 SHA256SUMS; do
            gh release view "${TAG}" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' | grep -qx "${asset}" \
              || { echo "ERROR: release asset missing: ${asset}" >&2; exit 1; }
          done
          COUNT="$(gh release view "${TAG}" --json assets --jq '.assets | length')"
          [ "${COUNT}" = "3" ] || { echo "ERROR: expected exactly 3 release assets, found ${COUNT}" >&2; exit 1; }
          LATEST_TAG="$(gh api "repos/${REPO}/releases/latest" --jq .tag_name)"
          [ "${LATEST_TAG}" = "${TAG}" ] || { echo "ERROR: latest release is ${LATEST_TAG}, expected ${TAG}" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "Release verification OK: ${TAG} is published, non-draft, non-prerelease, Latest, with 3 assets."
name: Make docker images

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"
      # iOS port tags (v<upstream>-ios.<rev>) ship native iOS binaries via
      # .github/workflows/ios-build.yml, not Docker images. Exclude them here
      # so iOS releases do not trigger unrelated image builds.
      - "!v*-ios.*"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 5
      matrix:
        include:
          # henrygd/beszel
          - image: henrygd/beszel
            dockerfile: ./internal/dockerfile_hub
            registry: docker.io
            username_secret: DOCKERHUB_USERNAME
            password_secret: DOCKERHUB_TOKEN
            tags: |
              type=raw,value=edge
              type=semver,pattern={{version}}
              type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
              type=semver,pattern={{major}}
              type=raw,value={{sha}},enable=${{ github.ref_type != 'tag' }}
            
          # henrygd/beszel-agent:alpine
          - image: henrygd/beszel-agent
            dockerfile: ./internal/dockerfile_agent_alpine
            flavor: latest=false
            registry: docker.io
            username_secret: DOCKERHUB_USERNAME
            password_secret: DOCKERHUB_TOKEN
            tags: |
              type=raw,value=alpine
              type=semver,pattern={{version}}-alpine
              type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}-alpine
              type=semver,pattern={{major}}-alpine

          # henrygd/beszel-agent-nvidia
          - image: henrygd/beszel-agent-nvidia
            dockerfile: ./internal/dockerfile_agent_nvidia
            platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
            registry: docker.io
            username_secret: DOCKERHUB_USERNAME
            password_secret: DOCKERHUB_TOKEN
            tags: |
              type=raw,value=edge
              type=semver,pattern={{version}}
              type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
              type=semver,pattern={{major}}
              type=raw,value={{sha}},enable=${{ github.ref_type != 'tag' }}

          # henrygd/beszel-agent-nvidia:slim
          - image: henrygd/beszel-agent-nvidia

    steps:
      - name: Checkout

      - name: Set up bun

        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v4

        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4

      - name: Docker metadata
        id: metadata
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v6
        with:
          images: ${{ matrix.image }}
          # Variant images must not overwrite the standard image's latest tag.
          flavor: ${{ matrix.flavor || 'latest=auto' }}
          tags: ${{ matrix.tags }}

      # https://github.com/docker/login-action
      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        env:
          password_secret_exists: ${{ secrets[matrix.password_secret] != '' && 'true' || 'false' }}
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && env.password_secret_exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          username: ${{ matrix.username || secrets[matrix.username_secret] }}
          password: ${{ secrets[matrix.password_secret] }}
          registry: ${{ matrix.registry }}

      # Build and push Docker image with Buildx (don't push on PR)
      # https://github.com/docker/build-push-action
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: ./
          file: ${{ matrix.dockerfile }}
          platforms: ${{ matrix.platforms || 'linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v6,linux/arm/v7' }}
          push: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' && secrets[matrix.password_secret] != '' }}
          provenance: mode=max
          sbom: true
          tags: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.labels }}

on:

    tags:
      - "v*"
      # iOS port tags (v<upstream>-ios.<rev>) are published by
      # .github/workflows/ios-build.yml instead. Exclude them here so

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Install dependencies

      - name: Build site

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6

      - name: Build .NET LHM executable for Windows sensors

          dotnet build -c Release ./agent/lhm/beszel_lhm.csproj
